subject: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan for exchanging the evaluation materials Atlas will share and Redwood's obligations for stewardship and sandbox access. High level: we want a short-lived, auditable access lane (1 week default) for your seed subset and promptpack so your team can validate latency/quality on our Dedicated trial.

Quick asks from Atlas to confirm so we can finalize the MAP and start the transfer:
- Confirm the sample CSV schema (row/column expectations) and whether PII has been removed.
- Accept the 7-day ephemeral access window for the initial trial (we can extend after acceptance).
- Confirm who on your side signs the MAP/SLA (DocuSign preferred) — I can route to Jeff on legal if needed.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 6/22: Redwood review + security checklist (SOC2 evidence stub provided).
- Wed 6/23: Push seed subset and promptpack to secure Drive folder; share access.
- Thu 6/24: Atlas runs tests; Redwood validates ingestion and provides token-level latency report.
- Fri 6/25: Close call and acceptance or list of action items.

Attachments: placeholder MAP_Acceptance_SLA_v3.pdf (draft), example CSV header.

LMK if that aligns. I can put together a narrow mutual-action doc and route for e-signature once you confirm PO/legal owner.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlasretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@storefront.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. Atlas is fine with the overall approach; a few notes from our side:

1) Data: the seed subset is a de-identified sample (hashed user ids, no free-text PII). We'll include a schema document with the CSV.
2) Access window: 7 days is acceptable for the initial trial. We expect automatic wipe after the window; can you confirm Redwood's deletion/retention steps?
3) Legal: please route the MAP to Jeff Daniels (Atlas legal). I'll loop him in after you send the DocuSign.

Also, can Redwood sign a brief usage covenant limiting the promptpack to evaluation only (no re-distribution)? We need that locked before we push the full prompt bundle.

Sam
Sam Torres
Head of AI Partnerships, Atlas Retail
sam.torres@atlasretail.com | +1 646-555-1220

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Jeff Daniels <jd@legaldocs.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule

Sam / Jeff —

Good to hear. Quick answers:
- Deletion: Redwood will perform a verified removal of the Drive folder and any cached artifacts after the agreed window. We will provide a deletion certificate (signed PDF) showing timestamps and operator id.
- Usage covenant: yes — the MAP draft includes a narrowly scoped eval-only covenant and a clause prohibiting redistribution. We're not asking for IP transfer; this is solely for transient evaluation.

I attached the updated MAP_Acceptance_SLA_v3.pdf (redline includes the usage covenant) and a small example seed file (atlas_seed_subset_v2.csv) with schema header only. Once Jeff signs, we'll enable a secure shared folder and upload atlas_promptpack_v1.zip (zipped prompts + a manifest).

Proposed DocuSign routing: Jeff for Atlas legal, then Sam (acceptance), then Redwood (Lauren for signature). If that works, I'll start the envelope now.

Ben

Attachments: MAP_Acceptance_SLA_v3.pdf, atlas_seed_subset_v2.csv

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlasretail.com>, Jeff Daniels <jd@legaldocs.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule

Looping in procurement/ops notes for closure cadence. A few operational constraints to confirm before we enable the shared folder:

- Access: we'll provision ephemeral credentials tied to a single operator account. Only two Redwood engineers (listed below) will have download privileges for the 7-day window.
- Audit: we will generate a token-level latency report and an access log export at the end of the window. We will not retain the files beyond the deletion certificate.
- Exceptions: any request to extend the window beyond 7 days must be approved by Atlas legal (Jeff) and logged in the MAP as an amendment.

Ben, please attach the DocuSign link when you send the envelope. Karthik — once signed, schedule a 30-minute ingestion check on Thu 6/24 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Customer Success (Operations)
lb@redwood.com

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlasretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jeff Daniels <jd@legaldocs.com>, Priya Shah <priya@storefront.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Controlled Seed Set Delivery + Promptpack Stewardship Schedule

Thanks everyone — Jeff has signed the DocuSign envelope and I countersigned. Confirming the following so it's captured in the MAP:

- 7-day ephemeral access window starts when Redwood uploads atlas_promptpack_v1.zip and confirms ingestion (expected today).
- Atlas will receive the deletion certificate within 48 hours of window close.
- Promptpack usage is limited to evaluation; Redwood agrees not to retain or redistribute content beyond the MAP.

I see the secure Drive folder link in the DocuSign confirmation and will validate the sample ingestion in the scheduled 10:00am PT slot tomorrow. If we need an extension, we'll file a formal amendment via the MAP doc.

Sam
